body:
(2 of 2, 26 Nov 2026 lead) WHAT IS NOT YET TRUE OF THE SERVER (the future-proofing check; each is an item or a new finding)
1. api.py was one 1,875-line file: SPLIT by P3-31 (PR follows; pure move, proven by an identical route dump + OpenAPI; a route-table test now pins every route with its module, so an admin route cannot appear unlisted).
2. NO downgrade guard: the migration runner ignores a database NEWER than the code (P3-29 part 2 was never built: grep finds no 'newer than' refusal). The Update button's 'way back' and any rollback image would run an old server on a newer database. Must exist before the Update button.
3. NO static or same-origin hosting and NO browser session. All auth is Authorization: Bearer (device token) or Subsonic u/t/s; openapi/docs are off. The admin pages and the later web player (P6-02) need ONE answer: same origin as the API, the owner's device token kept by the page, or a short session cookie with CSRF protection. To be decided in the design PR (P3-21), not twice.
4. NO setting store for the Host (above) and NO secret-key at install (P3-30: ND_PASSWORDENCRYPTIONKEY unset; the backup holds the identity key, the signing secret and a plain-text admin login).
5. The compose file follows the image tag `main` (ENCORE_TAG default): every server follows every merge (P3-27). The Update button must call a release channel, not 'latest'.
6. The helper (P3-25) does not exist: update/backup/restore are bash on the host. Design first (P3-21).

WHAT THE ADVISOR RULED FOR THE ORDER (26 Nov): P3-31 now (no server PR is open: cheapest moment), design PR for P3-20 + P3-21 + P3-25 together with the admin API in docs/17, P3-22 drawn only for what changed and FILED AS A PINK ITEM FOR THE OWNER with exact steps (nothing waits on it: the unchanged pages, People first, can be built), then P3-30 (permanent data + security: builder + one combined reviewer-attacker, one round). Nothing is deployed; VM 108 and the A35 are untouched.
